CanonicalKeywords.rationale: `{ CardKeyword.Eternal }` (Enthralled.cs:14) == `eternal = True`, and crucially NOT Unplayable -- Enthralled IS playable, which is the whole point of the card. The sim correctly leaves `is_playable` at True and `exhausts` at False, so playing it sends it to the discard pile on both sides.

ShouldPlay.rationale: All four clauses map exactly, in the same short-circuit order. `card.Owner != Owner -> true` (Enthralled.cs:23) is the multiplayer ownership gate, folded into the sim's single-player model. `Pile == null || Pile.Type != PileType.Hand -> true` (27-31) == `self not in self.combat.player.hand` (plus the no-combat guard). `card is Enthralled -> true` (32-35) == `isinstance(card, EnthralledCard)`. `autoPlayType != AutoPlayType.None -> true` (36-39) == the final `return auto_play`, and the sim's `auto_play` flag is exactly C#'s `autoPlayType != None` because `CombatState.auto_play_card` passes `auto_play=True` (combat.py:536) while the manual path passes the default False. This is the RIGHT hook, unlike card/clash, which routes an `IsPlayable` override through the same sim method -- C# `ShouldPlay` really is consulted on both the manual and the auto-play paths (CardModel.cs:1755, CardCmd.cs:64).

ctor.rationale: `base(2, CardType.Curse, CardRarity.Curse, TargetType.None)` (Enthralled.cs:16-19) == cost 2 / CURSE / CURSE / NONE. A REAL cost of 2, not the -1 sentinel the unplayable curses use, so the ascenders_bane cost finding does not apply and the sim's `_energy_cost = 2` is exact.

OnPlay.rationale: Enthralled.cs declares no OnPlay, so playing it costs 2 energy and does nothing -- a reachable no-op on both sides, since the card is playable.

ShouldGlowRedInternal.rationale: `protected override bool ShouldGlowRedInternal => true` (Enthralled.cs:10) is the red-highlight card visual. Presentation, out of scope.

guards.what: the sim adds `is_unpowered = True` (enthralled.py:31), which has no counterpart in Enthralled.cs
guards.rationale: Inert: the flag only steers `DamageCmd.deal`'s prop inference (cmds.py:44-50) and Enthralled deals no damage.
